preconditions.description: The input list must contain at least one number.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) for n in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list must be integers.

postconditions.description: The result must be one of the numbers in the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(len(str(n)) == len(str(result)) for n in numbers if len(str(n)) == len(str(result)))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple numbers with the same number of digits, the result must be the first one with that number of digits.

postconditions.expression: len(str(result)) == max(len(str(n)) for n in numbers)
postconditions.description: The result must have the maximum number of digits among all numbers in the input list.
